limits: Programme membership is not recorded on this server, so how many people are enrolled in a programme is not counted: only what was handed over under it. A programme with nothing handed over may still have members.

disclosure.basis: A count below 5 can identify a person in a barangay of this size, so it is withheld rather than shown. The threshold follows common statistical disclosure practice; the MSWDO has not yet confirmed a figure of its own.
